task: Write an execution plan for a stable, host-neutral owner-session contract for Lattice story owner leases.
outcome: User sees a committed execution document explaining that all hosts must bridge stable native session identity into LATTICE_SESSION_ID, with Codex/Claude Code/Antigravity examples, fallback rules, verification requirements, and two-host review requirements before implementation.
facts: Story owner lease is already implemented and gate-consumed for story-scoped mutating commands.
Current owner lease identity resolves LATTICE_SESSION_ID, then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, then derived ppid fallback.
Claude Code ppid instability was already recognized in code comments and smoke tests.
Codex wrapper currently sets LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SESSION from CODEX_SESSION_ID/OPENAI_SESSION_ID/TERM_SESSION_ID but does not bridge it to LATTICE_SESSION_ID.
The user wants a generic future-host contract, not another host-specific core special case.
constraints: This story is documentation-only; no runtime implementation changes are authorized.
Do not read or write docs/story or tests/fixtures directly.
The execution plan must preserve owner lease as local coordination, not cryptographic or Authority identity.
The plan must require two-host review before implementation proceeds.
unknowns: Whether Antigravity/agy exposes a native stable session environment variable; the plan must support both native env and generated dispatch token cases.
